finding: A story whose diff holds more than 128 KiB of paths, about 3000 paths, makes crap-score --base end in a traceback with exit 1 and no report. GATE_CHANGED_FILES is one environment string, and Linux refuses to start a program when one such string is longer than 128 KiB, so Popen in run_command raises OSError E2BIG. Nothing catches it, and exit 1 means "a judged function fails" in the exit codes of crap-score, so the gate-check step counts an attempt where the gate could not measure. crap-score at 38579fdc judges the same diff with exit 0. Reproduction: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-matthiasdaues-Documents-datenschoenheit-agent-factory/89fd1670-49e4-4a59-97db-e1035150aa04/scratchpad/st0451-review/repro_e2big.sh builds a story that adds 3000 files with 163890 bytes of paths and prints "OSError: [Errno 7] Argument list too long: '/bin/sh'". Fix: in run_command, catch OSError around Popen and raise GateError that names the measure, the command and the cause, so the gate exits 2. If large diffs must measure, a later decision can hand the paths in a file instead of a variable; that changes the contract of DEC-84.
why_this_severity: The code exists only on the story branch. The gate still stops the story and never passes it, and a diff of this size does not occur in this repository, whose tracked paths hold 172 KiB in total (no to fails_purpose). Whoever reads the result gets a traceback and a wrong exit code, and must find the cause.
